description: Land Title Settlement Department - Maha Heenatiyagala (Block 02), Kalutara D/S Division, Kalutara District  (25/120022)
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of "NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO LAND PARCELS" under the Registration of Title Act, dealing specifically with land ownership claims, cadastral maps, and title settlement processes for various land parcels in Kalutara and Kegalle districts. It falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it primarily deals with land registration, ownership claims, and property title matters.
